_comment: Single source of truth for backend base URLs. Consumed by scripts/setup-app.js (Node, build time) and config/environments.ts (runtime). localPort is the port a developer's local backend binds to by default per multicamp-backend/docs/MULTI_PROJECT_GUIDE.md. devHost/prodHost are the deployed VM hostnames; apiPath matches the Nginx location block for that project's backend.

mathmaster._comment: Unlaunched/experimental — no dedicated backend and no real production presence. Deliberately points 'prod' target at the LangoWords dev host, not a real prod host, so a mathmaster prod build never reaches production data.
